postconditions.expression: output_array == [] or all(output_array[i] in input_string for i in range(len(output_array)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output array is present in the input string.
Each character in the output array appears only once in the output array.

postconditions.expression: output_array == sorted(set([c for c in input_string if input_string.index(c) != input_string.rindex(c)]), key=lambda x: input_string.index(x))
postconditions.description: The output array contains characters that are repeated in the input string, ordered by their first repetition.
